headings.title: Registration of dental plan solicitors and agents
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: Prepaid dental corporations must register names of soliciting agents with director within thirty days after September 28, 1987.

headings.title: Rulemaking on agent licensing and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: Director rulemaking authority, after notice and hearing, for licensing, termination, and revocation of dental plan agents.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 354.721 (bid 19147), all 2 subsection(s) with subdivisions and source notes. Verified both subsections and source note (L. 1987 S.B. 272 § 11): agent registration within 30 days after Sept. 28, 1987 and permissive agent-licensing/revocation rulemaking after notice and hearing.

headings.title: Grounds for certificate suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: Five statutory grounds including charter violation, financial unsoundness, deceptive advertising, and hazard to enrollees.

headings.title: Administrative orders, level two penalties, and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to include revocation. Verified sub 2 (catchline mentions civil suit, omitted in body): director 'may' issue § 374.046 orders (level two under § 374.049) and may suspend or revoke certificate for willful violations.

headings.title: Restrictions on new enrollment and advertising during suspension
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: Enrolling new members (except newborns/dependents) and advertising or solicitation prohibited during suspension.

headings.title: Winding up of affairs upon certificate revocation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: Corporation must wind up affairs and cease business operations and advertising upon order of revocation.
